claims.quote: Pachypanchax arnoulti is a killifish endemic to western Madagascar, where it occurs in the Mahavavy du Sud and Betsiboka river systems.

regions.name: Lake Kinkony
regions.quote: Current known range includes the Mahavavy du Sud and Betsiboka river systems in western Madagascar, some first-order streams entering the Mozambique Channel between their mouths and Lake Kinkony plus its satellite lakes in the Mahavavy du Sud delta region.

regions.name: Kamoro River
regions.quote: Additional localities include a hill stream flowing from the Tampoketsa highlands and the upper Kamoro River basin, and may also occur in the Mahajamba and Soahany watersheds.
